redTeam.$comment: statusLabels defaults true (WE_RED_TEAM_STATUS_LABELS override); head-bound derived status only, recorded results remain authoritative. skipCardOnly defaults true; card-only net diffs never schedule a pass.

operatorRulings.$comment: anyState (R903, 2026-11-11: true; set false or WE_RED_TEAM_OPERATOR_RULINGS_ANY_STATE=false for round-cap-only): a human operator's record-red-team-ruling may rule card on a confirmed break in any state, so non-regression breaks are carded without waiting for the round cap. Automation still cannot rule; pending round extensions remain owned by automation.
